key_insight: AI can help decode and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites by linking degradation mechanisms, reliability prediction, and stabilization strategies.
engineering_relevance: The review frames AI as a practical tool for designing more durable perovskite devices under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress.
method: Consequence/reliability modeling and engineering stability enhancement
evidence_signal: The abstract highlights that AI is needed because existing studies face multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification challenges.
watch_item: Results may not transfer well across datasets or experiments without standardized protocols, strong benchmarks, and interpretable models.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
